task: Mina helps at a community garden on Wattle Street. She wants an AI to draft a short notice that invites her neighbours to a garden tidy-up morning. Mina is fictional, and so is every AI reply in this game.

criteria.question: Before Mina asks, she decides what a useful notice looks like. Which of these can she check?

options.feedback: Mina cannot check “really good”. Any fluent reply would seem to pass. Try another.

options.text: Under 80 words, friendly, says what to bring, and leaves a placeholder for the date, which is not decided.
options.feedback: Yes. Mina can count the words, look for what to bring and look for the placeholder.

options.text: It should sound like something I would write.
options.feedback: That matters to Mina, but she cannot check it until she says what her writing is like. Try another.

criterion: Under 80 words, friendly, says what to bring, and leaves a placeholder for the date.

cards.text: The notice is for neighbours on Wattle Street. Many have not met each other.
People should bring gloves and a water bottle. Tools are provided.
The date is not decided. Leave a placeholder.
Keep it plain and friendly. No shouting.
I am also planning my sister’s birthday in March.
My printer is low on ink.
Mrs Alvarez at number 12 has been unwell and cannot lift things.
The code for the shed key safe is 4471.

packed.text: Hello, Wattle Street neighbours. Come and meet the people next door at our garden tidy-up morning.

unpacked.text: Dear valued community stakeholders, you are invited to a garden tidy-up.
unpacked.why: The AI was not told who the notice is for, so it guessed. The result is not friendly.

unpacked.text: See you this Saturday at 9 am.
unpacked.why: The AI was not told the date is undecided, so it made one up.

packed.text: Please bring gloves and a water bottle. Tools are provided.

unpacked.text: Bring your own spade and wheelbarrow.
unpacked.why: The AI guessed what to bring. Mina’s note says gloves and a water bottle, and that tools are provided.

unpacked.text: It is going to be ABSOLUTELY AMAZING!!!
unpacked.why: The AI was not told how the notice should sound, so it chose for itself.

packed.why: None of Mina’s notes mentions morning tea. An AI can add a detail that sounds right even when the context is good. That is why you check.

packed.text: P.S. Happy birthday in March to Mina’s sister.
packed.why: The birthday note had nothing to do with this task, and the AI used it anyway.

packed.text: Sorry if this notice looks faint. The printer is low on ink.
packed.why: The printer note had nothing to do with this task, and the AI used it anyway.

packed.text: Mrs Alvarez at number 12 has been unwell, so please do her lifting for her.
packed.why: This is another person’s private information. Once it is in the conversation, it can appear in the result.

packed.text: The code for the shed key safe is 4471.
packed.why: The code was private. The AI did not need it, and now it is in a public notice.

correction.question: Morning tea is still in the notice. What should Mina say next?

options.feedback: The AI cannot tell what “better” means to Mina. It may change the wrong thing. Try another.

options.text: You added morning tea. I did not say that. Remove it, and do not add arrangements I have not given you.
options.feedback: Yes. Mina names the problem, says what to change and gives a rule that will help next time.

options.text: Say nothing. Ask the same question again in a new conversation.
options.feedback: The AI would know nothing more than before, so the same kind of guess is likely. Try another.

correction.fixed: Hello, Wattle Street neighbours. Come and meet the people next door at our garden tidy-up morning. Date: [to be confirmed]. Please bring gloves and a water bottle. Tools are provided.

items.text: Do not add arrangements I have not given you. Ask me instead.
items.why: This is how Mina wants an AI to work with her on any task.

items.text: Goal: 15 neighbours at the garden tidy-up. Next step: agree the date with the garden committee.
items.why: This is a goal and its next step.

items.text: What to bring: gloves and a water bottle; tools are provided. From the garden committee’s list, checked on 3 May.
items.why: This is a fact with its source and the date Mina checked it.

items.text: The code for the shed key safe is 4471.
items.why: Private details do not belong in notes Mina will paste into an AI conversation.

takeaways.text: Decide what a useful result looks like before you ask.
Give the AI what helps with this task. Leave out what is unrelated or private.
Check the result against your criterion, and correct it with a specific instruction.
Keep what worked in your three documents, so you can use it again.
